item.title: Asana的AI智能体可跨公司共享记忆，但不会泄露机密
item.summary: Enterprise teams building AI agents keep hitting the same wall: a chatbot that can answer a prompt but can't remember what the last five people asked it, and can't tell you whether last month's version actually worked.
